notes: Defect located in game/js/t3anims.js retargetClipToRig (main @ 99d5766f): the loop premultiplies EVERY track as quaternion with stride 4. retargetT3Clips emits a VectorKeyframeTrack '<Hips>.position' (stride 3, from root_t). On rigs whose Hips bind is non-identity (e.g. pantera Hips [0,.707,.707,0]) the position track enters the conversion branch: reads values[i+3] past group ends -> NaN, pushes a duplicate '<Hips>.quaternion' track with values.length = times*3 (not divisible by 4, NaN tail). Mixer evaluation propagates NaN -> renderer crash.
